33 of 1961 An Act to make provision for disqualifying the holders of
specified offices and persons belonging to the
Guyana Defence Force or the Guyana Police Force, or
interested in Government contracts, for membership
of the National Assembly.
[18TH JULY, 1961]
Short title. 1. This Act may be cited as the National Assembly
(Disqualification) Act.
L.R.O. 1/2012
